title: Ground-truth source files for the bash lessons
summary: The authoritative backing for the lessons here lives in bashqueues. Consult the named files before deviating from any invariant this sphere restates.
procedure: For sourced-library vs executed-tool roles and strict-mode scope read /usr/local/share/bashqueues/queuebash.sh near the direct-execution guard and the bin/queue-* tools.
For child rc capture and reserved codes read queuebash.sh in the worker wait region and the bin wrappers.
For argument/enum parsing and quoting read bin/queue-vcs-assert, bin/queue-vcs-probe, bin/queue-dev-timeout.
For file/write hygiene and command building read queuebash.sh (atomic candidate writes) and docs/IPC.md.
For JSON discipline read docs/QUEUE_COMMAND_CONTRACT.md, docs/QUEUE_DEV_CONTRACT.md and the bin/* JSON-emitting tools.

For the doctrine read docs/ACL_PROVIDER_CONTRACT.md, docs/QUEUE_DEV_AI_LESSONS.md, docs/QUEUE_DEV_ATTEMPT_EVIDENCE.md, docs/PLAN_ADAPTER_CONTRACT.md, docs/PROFILING_PATH_LOCK_CONTRACT.md, docs/QUEUE_DEV_SECURITY_MODEL.md.
invariants: A newer bashqueues file supersedes a quote restated here if they disagree.
Line numbers are observation anchors, not a contract; prefer the concrete file when verifying.
These are lessons and best practice, not a substitute for the authoritative source when you have it open.
